job.description:
Maintenance Technician

Job Title: Maintenance Technician

Location: Washington, Tyne and Wear

Salary: Up to £44,686.56 + £8,191.05 shift allowance (£52,877.61 total annual package)

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with an additional shift allowance.
  • Opportunity to develop your skills within an established manufacturing environment.
  • Potential career progression into a supervisory position.

The Company:

We are recruiting on behalf of an established manufacturing business based in Washington, Tyne and Wear. With a strong focus on operational efficiency, continuous improvement and maintaining high production standards, this company offers an excellent opportunity to join a busy engineering team.

They are looking for an experienced Maintenance Technician who can hit the ground running, take ownership of maintenance challenges and play a key role in keeping production running smoothly.

Working Hours:

Three-shift rotation:

  • Day Shift: 07:00 – 15:40
  • Back Shift: 15:30 – 23:25 (Friday finishes at 23:00)
  • Night Shift: 23:15 – 07:10 (Sunday starts at 23:20)

Benefits:

This Maintenance Technician opportunity offers a total annual package of up to £52,877.61, including shift allowance, alongside the chance to work with a variety of manufacturing equipment and contribute to ongoing engineering improvements.

Job Description:

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving manufacturing machinery to minimise downtime and maximise production efficiency.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Diagnosing mechanical and electrical faults, implementing effective repairs and resolving breakdowns.
  • Carrying out planned preventative maintenance on production equipment.
  • Installing, maintaining and refurbishing new and existing machinery.
  • Identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and increased equipment reliability.
  • Working closely with production teams, external suppliers and other departments.
  • Managing maintenance records, spare parts, purchase orders and stock levels.
  • Supporting safe working practices, quality standards and cost reduction initiatives.

Skills & Experience:

To be successful as a Maintenance Technician, you should have:

  • Proven experience maintaining and repairing machinery within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
  • Strong fault-finding and problem-solving abilities, with the confidence to work independently.
  • Experience carrying out preventative maintenance and responding to machinery breakdowns.
  • A proactive approach to continuous improvement, health and safety and equipment reliability.
  • Good communication skills and flexibility to work a rotating three-shift pattern.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Maintenance Technician looking for a well-paid position within an established manufacturing environment.

You'll benefit from a competitive salary package, varied engineering responsibilities and the opportunity to make a genuine impact on operational performance.

job.title: Project Engineer
job.description:
Project Engineer

Location: Bromsgrove

Working hours: 37.5 hours per week, Monday–Friday, 9am–5.30pm

Travel requirement: Up to 25% of the time

Position Summary

This role will work alongside the Project Manager.

The Project & Applications Engineer is responsible for developing designs, preparation of technical and commercial bids, preparing design calculations, drawing approvals, technical specifications and other associated documents to ensure proper system design and equipment selections. The Project & Applications Engineer provides engineering support to the sales team and to project management as required.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The major responsibilities of the position are listed below. To perform the job successfully, the individual must be able to execute each essential duty satisfactorily. Other duties, assignments, and specific projects may be assigned at the discretion of executive management.

  • Provide Applications support to the sales team and bid preparation, including costed commercial proposals for approval by the Sales Manager.

  • Research and review project requirements and design information to determine if it is sufficient to complete the design while ensuring that the design concept can be met.

  • Assist with the preparation of standard engineering documents and calculations.

  • Coordinate with Sales Managers, Project Managers and other team members to establish essential functions and deadlines necessary to finish specific projects.

  • Determine appropriate methods to create drawings.

  • Analyse reports, maps, drawings, tests, aerial photographs of terrain, existing and proposed characteristics, and other topographical and geologic data to plan and design projects.

  • Complete the drawing process using the information contained within the documents and in line with the Scope of Work.

  • Assess the commercial impact of different solutions for materials, process and performance requirements to establish the most appropriate selection to manage spend within project budgets.

  • Review drawings from suppliers and other supplier documentation as appropriate.

  • Assist with preparation of scopes and estimates for proposals.

  • R&D project work.

  • Troubleshooting client issues on and off site.

  • Other job duties as required.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent of demonstrated experience in a Chemical or Mechanical related engineering field.

  • Relevant experience in process plant and/or in air movement in ducts, fans and similar.

  • Experience with AutoCAD is beneficial.

  • Ability to work collaboratively within a creative, professional, team environment.

  • Type experience and/or civil or mechanical engineering experience is a plus.

Knowledge Skills and Abilities

To perform the job successfully, an individual must be able to execute each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and ability required.

Knowledge

Design — Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principles involved in production of precision technical plans, drawings, and models.

Engineering and Technology — Knowledge of the practical application of engineering science and technology. This includes applying principles, techniques, procedures, and equipment to the design and production of various goods and services.

Mechanical — Knowledge of machines and tools, including their designs, uses, repair, and maintenance.

Mathematics — Knowledge of arithmetic, algebra, geometry, calculus, statistics, and their applications.

Skills

Active Learning — Understanding the implications of new information for both current and future problem-solving and decision-making.

Active Listening — Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.

Critical Thinking — Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions or approaches to problems.

Mathematics — Using mathematics to solve problems.

Reading Comprehension — Understanding written sentences and paragraphs in work related documents.

Abilities

Near Vision — The ability to see details at close range (within a few feet of the observer).

Mathematical Reasoning — The ability to choose the right mathematical methods or formulas to solve a problem.

Visualization — The ability to imagine how something will look after it is moved around or when its parts are moved or rearranged.

Fluency of Ideas — The ability to come up with a number of ideas about a topic (the number of ideas is important, not their quality, correctness, or creativity).

Commercial Awareness — When considering solutions and specifying equipment performance consider the cost associated with the proposed action to control spending and contribute to overall budget cost controls.

Travel Requirement

Incumbents are expected to travel up to 25% of the time.

job.title: Quality Manager
job.description:
Quality Manager

Job Title: Quality Manager

Location: Durham, DH8

Salary: Circa £60,000 – £65,000 per annum

Benefits: Competitive benefits package

The Company

Our client is a well-established and growing manufacturing and engineering business operating across multiple sites in the North East of England. They are part of a larger group and operate in a fast-paced, operationally driven environment, delivering precision-engineered products to a diverse customer base. With a strong focus on continuous improvement, quality, and sustainable performance, this business is investing in its people and processes to build for the future. The Quality Manager will play a central role in shaping that journey.

Job Description

As Quality Manager, you will lead the Quality function across the business, taking full ownership of the Integrated Management System and ensuring products, processes and management systems meet customer requirements, regulatory expectations and ISO standards. Reporting to the Operations Director, the Quality Manager holds the authority to stop any activity where a quality risk is identified.

This is a hands-on leadership role joining a developing team. The Quality Manager will be expected to set clear standards, coach and develop team members, manage performance constructively, and drive a proactive quality culture across all sites.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead, develop and manage the Quality team, building capability and setting clear expectations through coaching, feedback and performance management.
  • Own, maintain and continually improve the Integrated Management System, ensuring compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001.
  • Act as primary contact for certification bodies; lead external audits, surveillance visits and re-certification activity.
  • Develop and manage the annual internal audit programme, ensuring findings are actioned and improvements embedded.
  • Develop, monitor and report on quality KPIs and performance data, using trends and insight to drive improvement.
  • Work cross-functionally with production, engineering, supply chain and commercial teams to resolve quality issues, identify root cause and implement corrective and preventative actions.
  • Support the Senior Leadership Team, contributing to wider business strategy and ensuring quality risks are considered in key decisions.
  • Oversee calibration and maintenance of quality equipment and ensure products are inspected in line with customer specifications and regulatory requirements.

Skills & Experience

To be considered for the Quality Manager opportunity, you will need:

  • Proven experience in a Quality leadership role within a manufacturing, fabrication or engineering environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001, with experience of owning or maintaining an Integrated Management System.
  • Experience leading internal and external audits and managing corrective actions through to completion.
  • Demonstrable experience developing and managing a team, including performance management and capability development.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, including root cause analysis and CAPA methodology.
  • Awareness of APQP, PPAP, FMEA and First Article Inspection processes.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders, build strong relationships and drive a quality-first culture.
  • Ideally educated to HNC, HND or Degree level in Quality Management, Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Audit training qualification; Lead Auditor desirable.

Why Should You Apply?

This is a genuine opportunity for an experienced Quality Manager to make a real and lasting impact. You will join a business that is investing in quality and continuous improvement, with the scope to shape how the function operates and develops. The Quality Manager role offers a competitive salary of circa £60,000 – £65,000, clear senior visibility through a direct report to the Operations Director, and the chance to influence wider business strategy as part of the Senior Leadership Team.

If you are a proactive, commercially aware Quality Manager who thrives in an operational environment and is ready to take ownership of a key function, we would love to hear from you.
